name: hcapp_addEditReceipt
description: Creates or updates an HC.Receipt record for an event expense. If @receiptId exists in the database, performs an update; otherwise inserts a new receipt. FFFFFFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFFFFFFFFFF is the sentinel UUID for clearing reimbursement data. After the write, delegates to hcapp_syncEventAdminData to return refreshed data.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token. Validated with errorType=3 on failure.

parameters.name: receiptId
parameters.description: Receipt to update, or a new UUID for insert. If not found in DB, SP falls through to insert mode with a new UUID.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Required. Null-UUID triggers a validation error.

parameters.name: reimbursedBy
parameters.description: User who reimbursed the expense. Null-UUID normalised to NULL. FFFFFFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFF-FFFFFFFFFFFF clears all reimbursement fields.

parameters.name: reimbursedOn
parameters.description: Reimbursement date as a string. CAST to DATETIMEOFFSET(7) internally — no error handling if cast fails. Values before 1/1/2000 normalised to NULL.
parameters.typeMismatch: String passed for date — brittle, no format validation.

parameters.name: reimbursedAmount
parameters.description: Negative values normalised to NULL. If @reimbursedBy is non-null and non-FFFFFFFF, overwritten from Receipt.ReceiptAmount.

parameters.name: receiptsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor passed through to hcapp_syncEventAdminData.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.Receipt — when @receiptId does not exist
EXEC hcapp_syncEventAdminData — returns multiple result sets (see syncEventAdminData contract)

codeSmells.issue: @reimbursedOn is NVARCHAR(50) cast to DATETIMEOFFSET — no error handling
codeSmells.detail: CAST(@reimbursedOn AS datetimeoffset(7)) will throw if the string is not a valid date. No TRY_CAST or TRY/CATCH. Any malformed date crashes the SP.
The all-F UUID is used as a magic value to clear reimbursement data. This is an unusual sentinel that callers must know about; it is undocumented in the parameter description.
No error handling, including for the risky date CAST.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the FFFFFFFF... sentinel UUID without updating all callers
